recentItems.title: Into The World Of Thangalaan - Part 2 | Pa. Ranjith Interview with Krishna | Chiyaan Vikram
recentItems.description:
In Part 2 of our on set series, explore the journey of director Pa. Ranjith as he brings "Thangalaan" to life, highlighting the rich history of KGF and his artistic vision. In this interview, he discusses collaborating with Vikram and the ensemble cast, and his openness to directing actors, provided they are ready to align with his ideology. 

Hosted and Conceptualised: Krishna
Camera: Ramesh Kannan & Surender

*This interview, shot on 5th April 2023 and was under embargo until now.*

The channel has also hosted shows which open up the lesser-known facets of filmmaking with conversations with PC Sreeram, Ravi Varman, Rajiv Menon, Thota Tharani, and Academy Award-winner Resul Pookutty. In other words, Film Companion South is for those who love their cinema and are unapologetic about it.

recentItems.title: The Tragedy Of Thoppil Ajayan, Who Never Made A Film After Classic Perumthachan | Video Essay
recentItems.description:
Thoppil Ajayan’s only film, the National-Award winning Perumthachan (1991), is considered an all-time classic of Malayalam cinema. Yet he never got to make a second film. This is a video essay about his 50-year-long pursuit to make a movie out of a fantasy novel named Manikyakallu, and how this dream took away the same life it created

recentItems.title: Raj B Shetty - The Mammootty Fan Interview with Kairam Vaashi | Roopanthara | Turbo | Toby
recentItems.description:
In this interview, Raj B Shetty shares his learnings from working with Mammootty, explains the nuances of acting, explains how he wrote 'Toby', 'Garuda Gamana Vrishabha Vahana' and 'Swathi Muttina MaLe Haniye'. Along with him giving us a glimpse of his upcoming film 'Roopanthara' (releasing on 26th Jul), we also get to explore the lyricist side of him.
